fixes.red_failure: n/a (test-only finding): the old test bypassed the framework via reflection; new cross-adapter cases go through req.parts()/form()/file() and passed on first run, so no production defect
fixes.rationale_full: Removed the reflection bodyStream helper and the stale class comment; the handler now uses req.parts()/req.form()/req.file() on an app configured with app.multipart(o -> o.tempDirectory(tmp)). Added mixed-field, spooled-part, maxFileSize/maxParts 413 and bad-boundary/truncated 400 cases asserting equal status+standard error body over InMemoryHttpAdapter and a TinyHttpd socket and an empty temp dir (FR-MULTIPART-001 AC-1/AC-2). Existing header-limit and 64 MiB tests kept, now via the accessors.

fixes.red_failure: n/a (test-only finding): AC-5 sizes (1048576 ok, 1048577 and 2x600000 -> 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE) and AC-2 heap bound (<8 MiB growth for 32 MiB upload) pass against existing code
fixes.rationale_full: Added app-level tests for FR-MULTIPART-004 AC-5 (three text sizes through req.form()/req.parts() with standard 413 body) and AC-2 (MemoryMXBean used heap after System.gc() before the upload and inside the handler holding the 32 MiB UploadFile). No production change needed.

fixes.red_failure: n/a (test-only finding): passes against existing code
fixes.rationale_full: Added app-level tests (maxFileSize, maxRequestSize, 21 parts, header line 8193, header total >16384 -> 413; missing/empty/too-long/invalid boundary, no delimiter, no close delimiter -> 400) asserting status, FR-APP-006 standard error body, that the accessor threw HttpException and onError saw it, and that the temp dir is empty. Parser-level tests kept.

params() now treats a backslash in a quoted value as an escape only before '"' or '\'; any other backslash is kept literally, so browser-sent raw names (a/b\c.txt, C:\fakepath\a.txt) reach filename() unchanged (FR-MULTIPART-004 AC-3/AC-4) while a\"b.txt still yields a"b.txt. The existing doubled-backslash test is untouched and still green. docs/api/multipart.md states the rule.

fixes.red_failure: AssertionError: expected:<[100000]> but was:<[java.lang.IllegalStateException: upload 'f' used after its request ended]>
fixes.rationale_full: Dispatcher releases uploads through an AtomicInteger(2) countdown decremented by res.onDone and by a finally after pipeline.run, so the request ends when the response finished and the handler returned, whichever is last. The existing error-path releases and the AFTER_ON_STOP participant remain. docs/api/multipart.md now says the request ends after the response finished and the handler returned, so respond-then-save works.

fixes.red_failure: AssertionError: expected null, but was:<attachment; filename="x.pdf">
fixes.rationale_full: answerFile's FileNotFoundException/IOException catch blocks remove the Content-Disposition header it added (only while the response is NEW) before throwing HttpException, so a user onError answer is not downloaded as an attachment.

fixes.red_failure: ArrayComparisonFailure: array lengths differed, expected.length=3000 actual.length=0
fixes.rationale_full: save() opens the content stream (which throws IllegalStateException on a released part) before the truncating FileOutputStream, so a second save or a save after the request ended leaves the destination intact; shared copy loop with transferTo. Public signatures unchanged.
